notes.title: Animaloid Girl will make a surprise appearance at Tokyo Game Show 2025!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44502454/723cfa9d05882a06d3b3bd0bdb10cdcf87a87d6e.png
Our upcoming title, “Animaloid Girl”, will make a surprise appearance at Tokyo Game Show 2025!
On the day, we will distribute a special “Art Book” to attendees.

This is a collection of images featuring a girl standing in Kowloon, captured from the latest in-game footage.
The cover features an original illustration by “Aiam iam”.

This art book is also a new release that serves as a sequel to the doujinshi “Animaloid Girl Track.2508,” which was distributed at Comic Market 106.

↓This image shows the front and back covers of the doujinshi “Animaloid Girl Track.2508” from Comic Market 106. TGS2025 will distribute this sequel-like art book.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44502454/53153679960e6428497c9f96f32a50acbe6f6711.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44502454/d6095d6f2157a3d886e58997b205ee0c590c5ffa.png

To realize the experience we envision—where you spend time alongside a girl gradually animalized and watch over her—development has taken longer than anticipated, causing delays. However, progress is steadily advancing.
As a progress update, we'd like to share a glimpse of the scenery depicted in the game's daily life segments.

Additionally, stickers allowing you to play a demo version of the adventure part will be distributed at the venue.


Shaping the story and game experience we envision inevitably takes time, but I hope to continue creating opportunities to share the process and progress bit by bit.

We would be delighted if you would continue to warmly support Animaloid Girl.

notes.title: COMICUP31 Exhibition Report & Next Event Announcement
notes.content:
First-time Participation at COMICUP31!
We joined COMICUP 31, a doujin event held in Hangzhou, China on May 17–18.
In addition to demo play sessions of Animaloid Girl and the distribution of doujin books, we also ran a special collaboration featuring 8 Japanese indie game titles.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44502454/1723fc8b11c85cf078dbfd6db51aa5e7ae6d007a.png

■Chinese-language Versions of Animaloid Girl Art & Setting Books Now Available!
As new releases for COMICUP31, we distributed the Chinese-language editions of two books:

 Animaloid Girl Track.2208, an illustration and setting materials collection
 Animaloid Girl Track.2408, a visual story book

Translation is handled by flankoi, known for their work on ghostpia and Return to Shironagasu Island.

■ Animaloid Girl Demo Play
We set up a demo station within our booth.
Many attendees played the game and shared their impressions with us.
Thank you so much!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44502454/25c5361603da0fd1dd637a2d71811a5d347a6785.png

■ Recommendation Campaign Featuring 8 Indie Titles with Strong Character, Worldbuilding, and Atmosphere
From the perspectives of “character,” “worldbuilding,” “atmosphere,” and “uniqueness,” we’ve selected 8 Japanese indie games that the Animaloid Girl team deeply respects.

Each of these titles will have free postcards available at our booth!
For this campaign, we specifically invited works rooted in Japanese anime and manga culture.

To help attendees discover each featured title, we handed out “latest edition postcards” for free.
They were so popular that most of them were gone by the second day!
Thank you to everyone who stopped by.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44502454/498bfa2a0501bd41da6b60e4668a91753cf2ded2.jpg

【Title List】
・Animaloid Girl
・ghostpia Season One
・Maid Cafe on Electric Street
・Tokyo Stories
・FUBUKI ~zero in on Holoearth~
・UsoNatsu ~The Summer Romance Bloomed From A Lie~
・Severed Love
・LATE FEE GIRLS


■ghostpia Season One as SPECIAL GUEST Trial Booth
We also set up a demo station for ghostpia Season One, a visual novel by Chosuido, who collaborated with us on the “Outing Clear Cards.”

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2192620/ghostpia/

Animaloid Girl Outing Clear Cards Set – Design by Chosuido
This playful and layered card set includes:

 SNS-style frames based on the fictional social platform KOWLOOOOOOOON featured in the game
 Character photo cards inspired by instant film (cheki-style)
 Background cards of real-life Hong Kong locations for “pilgrimage photography”


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44502454/c80a13030bd0b3239b985cbcd4d1f0dd478dcbb9.jpg

Our decision to attend COMICUP this time was driven by a desire to help more people learn about Animaloid Girl.
We were deeply encouraged to see so many visitors come specifically for Animaloid Girl and the other featured titles.
Thank you so much!

We'll keep working hard on development!

We will be exhibiting at the Japanese indie game event “DREAMSCAPE#3”!
This is a real event featuring only visual novels and will be held on May 24th in Shinjuku.

At the event, we will be launching a brand-new ZINE titled “Kowloon Core.”

notes.title: We will exhibit at “Tokyo Game Dungeon 8”!
notes.content:
Exhibit at “Tokyo Game Dungeon 8”!
You can play a demo of the adventure part at booth 【2E-10】!
[previewyoutube=0_2ZIqs1yHk;full][/previewyoutube]
You’ll be able to experience a more refined version of the dialogue scene from the TOKYO INDIE GAMES SUMMIT 2025 build.

This particular scene captures a single day from the calendar-based progression of the game’s year.
 It portrays a moment between the girl and the protagonist—passing each other by, struggling to put their feelings into words, yet quietly caring for one another.
 
 The girl, facing anxiety over her gradual transformation into an Anima, finds a glimmer of hope through the protagonist’s presence.
It’s a scene that explores emotions difficult to express—uncertainty about the future, and the quiet, fragile belief that something good might still be waiting ahead.

【Schedule】
May 4, 2025 (Sun.) 12:00-17:00

【Venue】
Tokyo Metropolitan Industrial Trade Center, Hamamatsucho Kan 2F, Space “2E-9”!

【Link】

 Tokyo Game Dungeon 8 official website:https://tokyogamedungeon.com
 Click here to purchase tickets:https://passmarket.yahoo.co.jp/event/show/detail/020kwj4fcec41.html



In addition, we will be distributing “Outing Clear Cards,” which were well received at the Japanese indie game event “Burari Kawagoe GAMEDIGG,” which we exhibited at in April!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44502454/cf44acac1303e3f67320843623d1cd524ebf4c75.png
This new merch set includes two clear overlay cards—perfect for taking photos that blend with real-world scenery—and a background card featuring real Hong Kong locations that inspired the world of Animaloid Girl.

The set was planned by PANDRI-DON, with beautiful card designs by Chosuido, the creators of ghostpia.
We also received production and card specification support from Eiri Kondou of Internet Eden.

As a special bonus, if you purchase the set and share a photo on social media, we’ll gift you an exclusive “Human Ver.” card!
 Don’t miss your chance to pick one up and join in the fun.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44502454/d4edf8a29d0384e557631de65c79711b2e9bd6bd.png

Merch as a Window Into the World of Animaloid Girl
All Animaloid Girl merchandise is designed to enrich and expand the world of the game.
The new “Outing Clear Cards” are based on Kowloooooooon, the in-game social network used by the girl.

 The logo features a neon-inspired design, and the extra-long “o” is a nod to the lucky number 8 in Hong Kong culture.
 The airplane icon reflects the iconic angle of planes descending near the Kowloon Walled City—this SNS is imagined as a fictional platform born out of Hong Kong.
 
We imagined the girl using this SNS to post snapshots of her outings—maybe she wanted to share a moment from a place she visited, or send a message to someone far away. That little story became the spark for this item.

Many of our previous merch items also carry subtle elements that deepen the lore of the world.
 If you already own some, we hope you'll enjoy piecing things together and letting your imagination fill in the gaps.
 
Thank you as always for your continued support of Animaloid Girl.

notes.title: Main music by "Noriyuki Iwadare" & "Kowloonoid FM" pre-release!

【Main music will be composed by "Noriyuki Iwadare"】
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44502454/2c2cd086d681105df6adae0297610fdc286906f5.png
Noriyuki Iwadare, a musician who has composed music for Ace Attorney, GRANDIA, and Tokyo Disney Resort, will be the main musician for this title.
The playable demo at BitSummit Drift will include new music by Noriyuki Iwadare.
Together with the theme song composed by "DÉ DÉ MOUSE" already included in the PV, it will color the world of the Animaloid girl.
[previewyoutube=0Q8VM4zcJrU;full][/previewyoutube]


【A radio station appeared in the game! Linked with real distribution program on Youtube!】
[previewyoutube=W6Ich-kNTF8;full][/previewyoutube]
Kowloonoid FM, a fictional radio station, appears in the in-game world!
In the game, it is positioned as a popular music distribution radio for the residents and is involved in the storyline. You can freely listen to it as background music in the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44502454/a36796ca806c152dcee02878bbded1ae8bc6f05e.jpg
The first artist to participate in the music will be chiptune artist "Rei8Bit".

Furthermore, "Kowloonoid FM" will also appear in real life on Youtube!
The Youtube version will be a 24-hour Lo-Fi Music program.
The in-game "Kowloonoid FM" and the Youtube version of "Kowloonoid FM" will have a parallel world relationship, and although they are not the same, they will be linked so that the same music can be heard in the game, making the in-game world more familiar to the user, as if it were a real memory.
The Youtube version will play stills animated Live2D in-game + Lo-fi Music.

notes.title: Introducing “Animaloid Girl Track.2308“
notes.content:
I had a dream. I was surrounded by things I didn't know and I was falling. I had a strange sensation that I was no longer me, and I always woke up.......

The first and second installments of the "Animaloid Girl Track. series" were books, and the third installment is a T-shirt. The illustration, drawn exclusively for this series, depicts the dream world of a girl who has moved to Kowloonoid City. It depicts the city motifs such as the streets of Hong Kong Kowloon, gaziets, and food.
This illustration is also the animaroid girl's fourth key visual, and expresses the mixed feelings of "anticipation and anxiety" of a girl who has come to a foreign country alone.

Strange city and me
That person likes this city. They say it's messy and chaotic and that's what they like about it, but...I still don't know what it's like.
But I know there are good food, beautiful places, and fun things to do here. ...I want to know more about it in the future.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44502454/e3d1f7922e3295b18c10e1debd78104a3bada6a2.png

A story of a young girl who is changing into a furry.
This is a setting material book full of "kemonomimi," in which "Iamu I am" depicts the days of a girl who is changing from human to animal. In addition to many illustrations used in the main game, the setting materials also include designs for school uniforms and private uniforms, settings for the animalize.

The back cover is an illustration depicting the world in which it is set, with an image of the chaotic city of Hong Kong "Kowloon Fortress" x "Tokyo" mix.

This book is filled with the concept of the Animaloid Girl.
We are particular about the color of the illustrations, and all pages are made of satin-kinfuji, a high quality paper.
It is now on sale at BOOTH.

I saw the Kowloon City area and the Upper Ring, which is also the motif of the game "Kowloonoid City".

notes.title: New Year's Greetings
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44502454/1ced5d1d6f2b314cebdab09df15c230303993b92.png
Happy New Year!

In Hong Kong, where "Animaloid Girl" takes place, the New Year is celebrated during the Chinese New Year, or Chinese New Year's Day. The date changes every year, but this year, February 10 (Sat.) to 13 (Tue.) will fall on the Chinese New Year.

Although a month has already passed since New Year's Day in Japan, we would like to celebrate the New Year once again.
We hope you will continue to support "Animaloid Girl" this year as well.
